name: weibo-cli
title_zh: 终端里直接抓微博公开数据，JSON 原样到手
tagline_zh: 写脚本或 Shell 会话时，不用开浏览器、不用配 MCP 客户端，一条命令把微博公开数据拉成 JSON。
tagline_en: For scripts and shell sessions: skip the browser and MCP client, pull public Weibo posts as clean JSON with one.
desc_en: Query public Weibo data from a terminal with the bundled weibo-cli command. Use for direct JSON retrieval in scripts or shell sessions; do not use when an MCP client should call tools itself.
why_zh: 把 MCP 工具拆成独立 CLI，绕开客户端调度层，让数据流直通脚本；适合批量抓取。
why_en: It decouples the MCP tool into a standalone CLI, cutting out the client layer so data flows straight into pipelines—ideal for.
limit_zh: 只返回公开可见数据，登录态、私密内容、评论互动等拿不到；且仅限命令行直取，若你的场景是 MCP 客户端内调用工具。
limit_en: Public data only—no login, DMs, or interactions. CLI-only; if your MCP client should call tools itself, skip this.
title_en: Fetch public Weibo data as JSON straight from your terminal
